description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt firmware project. It manages the status LED behavior during different system states, including restoring triggers, setting LED states for preinit, failsafe, upgrade, and completion scenarios.

methods.name: status_led_restore_trigger
methods.description: Restores the default trigger for the status LED based on device tree information.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED behavior based on the system state parameter, such as preinit, failsafe, upgrade, or done.
